klein:1895.author: Felix Klein (ausgearbeitet von F. Tägert)
klein:1895.work: Vorträge über ausgewählte Fragen der Elementargeometrie
klein:1895.locus: Leipzig: B. G. Teubner (v + 66 S., 10 Fig., 2 lithogr. Tafeln)
klein:1895.note: First German edition; Festschrift prepared for the Elberfeld Oberlehrer gathering from Klein's Göttingen Easter 1895 holiday course. Public domain.

klein:1897.author: Felix Klein (trans. W. W. Beman & D. E. Smith)
klein:1897.work: Famous Problems of Elementary Geometry: The Duplication of the Cube, The Trisection of an Angle, The Quadrature of the Circle
klein:1897.locus: Boston and London: Ginn & Company (ix + 80 pp.)
klein:1897.note: Authorized first English translation from Teubner's 1895 German text (unencumbered by Archibald's 1930 annotations). Public domain.

klein:1872.author: Felix Klein
klein:1872.work: Vergleichende Betrachtungen über neuere geometrische Forschungen
klein:1872.locus: Erlangen: Verlag von Andreas Deichert (48 S.); reprinted in Mathematische Annalen 43 (1893), pp. 63–100
klein:1872.note: Klein's inaugural Erlangen Program monograph classifying geometries as invariant theories of transformation groups. Public domain (Project Gutenberg #38033).

klein:1893:erlangen.author: Felix Klein (trans. M. W. Haskell)
klein:1893:erlangen.work: A Comparative Review of Recent Researches in Geometry
klein:1893:erlangen.locus: Bulletin of the New York Mathematical Society 2 (10), July 1893, pp. 215–249
klein:1893:erlangen.note: Authorized English translation of the Erlangen Program with Klein's 1893 Prefatory Note. Public domain (arXiv:0807.3161).

klein:1871:noneuclid.author: Felix Klein
klein:1871:noneuclid.note: Established the projective Cayley–Klein models of hyperbolic, elliptic, and parabolic metric geometries; summarized in Erlangen Note V.

klein:1872:linien.author: Felix Klein
klein:1872:linien.note: Connected Plücker's 4D line quadric in P^5 with Lie's sphere geometry and non-Euclidean metric transformations (Erlangen §§ 5 & 7).

gauss:1801.author: Carl Friedrich Gauss
gauss:1801.work: Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, Sectio Septima: De aequationibus circuli sectiones definientibus
gauss:1801.note: Proved constructibility of regular polygons of Fermat-prime order p = 2^(2^mu) + 1 and gave the explicit period reduction for p = 17.

wantzel:1837.author: Pierre Laurent Wantzel
wantzel:1837.work: Recherches sur les moyens de reconnaître si un problème de Géométrie peut se résoudre avec la règle et le compas
wantzel:1837.locus: Journal de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées (Liouville) 2, pp. 366–372
wantzel:1837.note: First complete algebraic proof of the degree-2^h necessity criterion, settling Delian duplication, angle trisection, and non-Fermat polygons.

eisenstein:1850.author: Gotthold Eisenstein
eisenstein:1850.work: Über die Irreductibilität und einige andere Eigenschaften der Gleichung, von welcher die Theilung der ganzen Lemniscate abhängt
eisenstein:1850.locus: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 39, pp. 160–179 (p. 167)
eisenstein:1850.note: Source of Eisenstein's p-divisibility irreducibility criterion applied by Klein in Famous Problems Part I, Ch. III, §§ 7–8.

richelot:1832.author: Friedrich Julius Richelot
richelot:1832.work: De resolutione algebraica aequationis X^257 = 1, sive de divisione circuli per bisectionem anguli septies repetitam in partes 257 inter se aequales commentatio coronata
richelot:1832.locus: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 9, pp. 1–26, 146–161, 209–230, 337–357
richelot:1832.note: Explicit cyclotomic resolution of the regular 257-gon (Famous Problems Part I, Ch. III, § 1).

hermes:1894.author: Johann Gustav Hermes
hermes:1894.work: Über die Teilung des Kreises in 65537 gleiche Teile
hermes:1894.locus: Nachrichten von der Kgl. Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, Math.-phys. Klasse 1894, Nr. 3, pp. 170–186
hermes:1894.note: Summary of Hermes's ten-year period computation for the regular 65537-gon stored in Göttingen.

bachmann:1872.author: Paul Bachmann
bachmann:1872.work: Die Lehre von der Kreistheilung und ihre Beziehungen zur Zahlentheorie
bachmann:1872.note: Standard cyclotomy treatise recommended by Klein in Famous Problems Part I, Ch. III–IV.

petersen:1879.author: Julius Petersen
petersen:1879.work: Methods and Theories for the Solution of Problems of Geometrical Constructions (and Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen, 1878)
petersen:1879.locus: Copenhagen: Andr. Fred. Høst & Søn / London: Sampson Low
petersen:1879.note: Praised by Klein in Famous Problems Introduction (p. 2) for elementary algebraic proofs of geometric constructibility (geometor/petersen).

lemoine:1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine:1902.work: Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine:1902.note: Quantitative complexity calculus of compass-and-straightedge constructions complementing Klein's restricted-instrument hierarchy (geometor/lemoine).

mascheroni:1797.author: Lorenzo Mascheroni
mascheroni:1797.note: Proved compass-only constructibility of all Euclidean points (Famous Problems Part I, Ch. IV, § 7).

poncelet:1822.author: Jean-Victor Poncelet
poncelet:1822.work: Traité des propriétés projectives des figures
poncelet:1822.note: Foundational treatise on central projection, ideal elements, and single-circle straightedge constructions.

steiner:1833.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1833.work: Die geometrischen Konstruktionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und eines festen Kreises
steiner:1833.note: Proved sufficiency of straightedge + one fixed circle with known center for all quadratic constructions.

staudt:1842.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1842.locus: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 24, p. 252 (also Geometrie der Lage, 1847)
staudt:1842.note: Original single-circle straightedge construction of the regular 17-gon adapted by Schröter and Klein.

schroeter:1872.author: Heinrich Schröter
schroeter:1872.work: Zur v. Staudtschen Construction des regulären Siebzehnecks
schroeter:1872.locus: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle) 75, pp. 13–24
schroeter:1872.note: Direct geometric model for Klein's fixed-circle quadratic period solver in Famous Problems Part I, Ch. IV, §§ 8–9.

sundara-row:1893.author: T. Sundara Row
sundara-row:1893.note: Cited by Klein in Famous Problems Part I, Ch. V, § 1 on origami constructions.

cantor:1874.author: Georg Cantor
cantor:1874.work: Über eine Eigenschaft des Inbegriffes aller reellen algebraischen Zahlen (and Über eine elementare Frage der Mannigfaltigkeitslehre, 1891)
cantor:1874.locus: Crelle's Journal 77, pp. 258–262; Jahresbericht der DMV 1, pp. 75–78
cantor:1874.note: Countability of algebraic numbers by height N and diagonal proof of uncountability of the continuum (Famous Problems Part II, Ch. I).

rudio:1892.author: Ferdinand Rudio
rudio:1892.work: Archimedes, Huygens, Lambert, Legendre. Vier Abhandlungen über die Kreismessung
rudio:1892.note: Historical source anthology underlying Famous Problems Part II, Ch. II.

hermite:1873.author: Charles Hermite
hermite:1873.locus: Comptes Rendus de l'Académie des Sciences 77, pp. 18–24, 74–79, 226–233, 285–293
hermite:1873.note: First proof of the transcendence of Euler's constant e.

lindemann:1882.author: Ferdinand Lindemann
lindemann:1882.note: Proved the transcendence of pi and impossibility of squaring the circle via 1 + e^(i*pi) = 0.

gordan:1893.author: Paul Gordan
gordan:1893.locus: Mathematische Annalen 43, pp. 222–224 ( alongside Hilbert pp. 216–219 & Hurwitz pp. 220–221)
gordan:1893.note: Purely algebraic operator proof (h^r = r!) of Hermite's and Lindemann's theorems presented in Famous Problems Part II, Chs. III–IV.

abakanowicz:1889.author: Bruno Abdank-Abakanowicz (trans. Emil Bitterli)
abakanowicz:1889.work: Die Integraphen: Die Integralkurve und ihre Anwendungen
abakanowicz:1889.locus: Leipzig: B. G. Teubner (French original: Paris, Gauthier-Villars, 1886)
abakanowicz:1889.note: Mechanical continuous-motion quadrature of the circle analyzed in Famous Problems Part II, Ch. V / Anhang.

cayley:1859.author: Arthur Cayley
cayley:1859.locus: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London 149, pp. 61–90
cayley:1859.note: Subsumed metrical geometry under projective invariants relative to the Absolute quadric (Erlangen §§ 1–2, § 10, Note V).

riemann:1854.author: Bernhard Riemann
riemann:1854.work: Über die Hypothesen, welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen
riemann:1854.locus: Abhandlungen der Kgl. Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen 13
riemann:1854.note: Introduced n-dimensional manifolds and constant-curvature metrics contrasted and unified with projective group theory in Erlangen § 10 & Notes IV–VI.

lie:1872.author: Sophus Lie
lie:1872.work: Über Complexe, insbesondere Linien- und Kugel-Complexe, mit Anwendung auf die Theorie partieller Differential-Gleichungen (and Theorie der Transformationsgruppen, 1888–1893)
lie:1872.note: Lie's contact transformations and line-to-sphere correspondence featured in §§ 7 & 9 of the Erlangen Program.

euclid:elements.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid:elements.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements.locus: Cambridge University Press, Books I & IV
euclid:elements.note: Classical straightedge-and-compass postulates and regular polygon constructions (geometor/euclid, geometor/elements).

kepler:1619.author: Johannes Kepler
kepler:1619.work: Harmonices Mundi, Liber I: De figuris regularibus harmonicis
kepler:1619.note: Philosophico-geometric analysis of constructible ('knowable') vs. non-constructible ('unknowable') regular polygons including the heptagon (geometor/kepler).

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1899.note: Axiomatic characterization of problems solvable with straightedge and segment-transferrer (Eichmass) over Pythagorean vs. Euclidean fields (geometor/hilbert).

russell:1897.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1897.work: An Essay on the Foundations of Geometry (and The Principles of Mathematics, 1903)
russell:1897.note: Philosophical and logicist reception of Klein's Cayley–Klein metageometry and Erlangen hierarchy (geometor/bertrand-russell).

hoenen:1954.author: Petrus H. J. Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen:1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen:1954.locus: Analecta Gregoriana Vol. LXIII, Rome: Pontificia Universitas Gregoriana
hoenen:1954.note: Epistemological examination of Klein's group-theoretic structuralism and non-Euclidean models (geometor/hoenen).

pappus:collection.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:collection.note: Ancient classification of plane, solid, and linear constructions and projective cross-ratio invariance (geometor/pappus).

wildberger:2005.author: Norman J. Wildberger
wildberger:2005.work: Divine Proportions: Rational Trigonometry to Universal Geometry
wildberger:2005.note: Algebraic invariant formulation of Euclidean and Cayley–Klein geometries via quadrance and spread (geometor/wildberger).
